proves.claim: Init in a copy of a scratch Go module records go test ./... as the gate.

cli.journeys-languages-go.init-records-g.why: Without it, a regression where init stops detecting a plain Go module would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A submitted commit with a failing go test is refused red and the refusal names the test.

cli.journeys-languages-go-red.a-failing-.why: Without it, a regression where a red Go gate is accepted or its refusal hides the failing test would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The fixed Go commit passes go test ./..., is accepted and lands on the scratch board main.

cli.journeys-languages-go-land.the-fixed.why: Without it, a regression where a green Go item cannot land would pass unnoticed.
